new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    for sr, sc, er, ec in ((-dr, -dc, r, c), (dr, dc, rr, cc)):
                        y, x = er + sr, ec + sc
                        while 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and grid[y][x] == bg:
                            out[y][x] = color
                            y += sr
                            x += sc
    return out
'''
